extra_context: We're a small day spa tucked just off the main road, mostly serving busy women in their 30s and 40s who need a real reset, plus the occasional couple coming in for an anniversary. I want people to exhale the second they walk through the door, like the noise of the day just gets left at the threshold. The one thing that's really us: every treatment starts with a warm foot ritual and a cup of cedar-and-chamomile tea before you even get to the table, so you arrive slowly instead of being rushed onto it.
